cards.name: Gigantes
cards.behavior: Special Summon from the active seat's private hand by banishing one EARTH monster from the team's shared GY; if destroyed by battle and sent to its owner's GY, destroy all Spell/Trap cards on both team fields, including the separate Field Zone.

cards.name: Fenrir
cards.behavior: Special Summon from the active seat's private hand by banishing two WATER monsters from the team's shared GY; when it destroys an opponent monster by battle, schedule that team's next Draw Phase skip.

cards.name: Inferno
cards.behavior: Special Summon from the active seat's private hand by banishing one FIRE monster from the team's shared GY; when it destroys an opponent monster by battle and sends it to the GY, inflict 1500 shared team LP damage.

cards.name: Silpheed
cards.behavior: Special Summon from the active seat's private hand by banishing one WIND monster from the team's shared GY; if destroyed by battle and sent to its owner's GY, the opposing active seat discards one random private-hand card using the persisted HMAC duel stream.

coveredFamilies: shared-team GY costs with physical UID preservation
HMAC random discard from active opponent private hand
3+3 shared zones and separate Field Zone
Deck 20–30 / hand 6 at End Phase / Extra 5

limitations: Adapters e testes isolados; os quatro cards ainda não foram adicionados ao effectRegistry/cardMetadata/cardCertifications.
Fenrir Draw Phase skip precisa de integração ao fluxo central de compra para afetar partidas reais.
A resolução de Gigantes/Inferno/Silpheed depende de hooks centrais de batalha/saída do campo.
A CI remota ainda precisa executar typecheck, build, 31 testes focados, regressão integral e auditoria.
